Boundary Type: ADM1
Canonical Boundary Type Name: states
Source 1: South Sudan Information Management Working Group (IMWG), National Bureau of Statistics (NBS), and OCHA
Source 2: OCHA South Sudan
Release Type: gbOpen
License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY 3.0 IGO)
License Notes:

Link to Source Data: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/south-sudan-administrative-boundaries
Other Notes: The Abyei region does not exist in the Admin1 layer but is included in the Admin2 layer. For representation on map, the north of the Abyei region boundary should be dotted and the fill colour should be the same as neighbouring countries. The undetermined boundary between South Sudan and Sudan should be dashed and the undetermined boundary of the Illemi triangle, between Kenya and South Sudan should be dashed for the two sides within South Sudan and the third side which borders Kenya should be solid. The relevant shapefile line features are split to enable this.

xml_selected.text: South Sudan National Bureau of Statistics
Administrative boundaries (Level 1 - States) Digitised from Russian Topo maps 200k (1970)

Layer was downloaded as a shapefile by ITOS from the UNOCHA COD FOD Registry. It was then analyzed by ITOS for errors. Those errors were corrected and then the layer was sent back to UNOCHA as a feature class within a file geodatabase.

The following errors were found and fixed by ITOS:
1. Created and populated reference name field
2. 10 gap errors and 11 overlap topology errors were fixed on the borders of Warrap

The following errors were found and left as is by ITOS:
1. The Abyei region does not exist in this Admin1 layer and does exist in the Admin2 layer so the two layers do not nest.

actual_work: Confirmed with east researcher that previous work had frozen release bodies/metadata, not original SSD source archives; no prior exact-archive denial or local copy was identified. Public GitHub contents reads yielded LFS SHA256/size descriptors.
Acquired each exact original sourceData archive through narrow normal per-command approval. Both downloads finished exit0; bytes and SHA256 matched descriptors.

Read actual meta.txt and XML documentary content/process logs; inspected selected DBF attributes only; did not parse or reconstruct SHP geometry. Visual inspection of license.PNG showed generic HDX license explanation, not a dataset-specific boundary methodology.
Read actual OCHA2009 map source legend by text extraction and full-page rendering. No population import, coordinate extraction or map georeferencing was performed.

substantive_findings.finding: Temporal source lineage is older than represented2020.
substantive_findings.evidence: Both XML abstracts state digitization from Russian1:200,000 topographic maps (1970). XML creation2008-12-01, publication2013-01-14, revision2016-01-14; processing sets original date12/1/2008 and validOn1/14/2016. Name/Level mapping occurred10Oct2017.
substantive_findings.limit: The2020 label describes representation, not a demonstrated2020 survey or international-boundary revision.

substantive_findings.finding: Actual original features match the target source identities by family/ordinal/name.
substantive_findings.evidence: ADM1 has10records, WesternEquatoria ordinal8, ISO SS-EW. ADM2 has78records, Ezo52 andTambura53. These ordinals match the consumed native source operands.
substantive_findings.limit: Attribute/ordinal identity is lineage, not territorial qualification or positive cell attribution.

substantive_findings.finding: Recorded topology correction is geographically limited.
substantive_findings.evidence: ADM1 statement names10gaps and11overlaps on Warrap borders; ADM2 names one gap between Juba and MundriEast. Both retain ADM1/ADM2 nonnesting at disputedAbyei.
substantive_findings.limit: No inspected record names a repair of the DRC international boundary, and no such repair is inferred from generic cleanup.

substantive_findings.finding: International-edge symbology notes have explicit geographic scope.
substantive_findings.evidence: Meta.txt specifies dotted/dashed representation for Abyei, the Sudan–SouthSudan undetermined boundary and Illemi triangle; relevant line features are split for that purpose.
substantive_findings.limit: Those instructions do not state a DRC edge exception. Each inspected ZIP contains one polygon SHP plus ancillary files; no separate boundary-line dataset is included. Absence of a DRC exception is not affirmative validation of its edge.

substantive_findings.finding: Source construction is digitized cartography with missing sheet-level controls.
substantive_findings.evidence: Russian map scale/year family is named, but exact sheet number, edition, boundary depiction/registration controls and DRC-specific tracing rules are not identified in inspected original metadata. Output PRJ is WGS84.
substantive_findings.limit: WGS84 output does not establish the original Russian-map datum transformation, nor an adopted modern boundary line.

primary_cartographic_followup.title: 5th Sudan Census2008 – PopulationDensity byCounty
primary_cartographic_followup.inspection: One-page PDF downloaded, text extracted and rendered; source legend visually read.
primary_cartographic_followup.result: The legend attributes national and state boundaries to Russian Sudan map series1:200k from the1970s, while county administrative units are digitized based on SSCCSE StatisticalYearbook2009. OCHA is named as digitizer. WesternEquatoria, Ezo andTambura are named on the map. The map explicitly does not imply UN endorsement or Government acceptance of boundaries/names.
primary_cartographic_followup.interpretation: Corroborates historical national/state mapping provenance and distinguishes county construction. It is not the original Russian sheet and does not establish exact equivalence to the frozen source archive. No geometry was compared or substituted. Population values are incidental source evidence only, with no import or acceptance.

prior_observation_correction.statement: Do not use inherited claims of zero SSD center hits. East reported that the537-feature overlay omitted SSD ADM1 andADM2 as well as CAFADM3. The omission prevents that overlay from supporting absence of SSD contacts.
prior_observation_correction.disposition: This report makes no center-hit or full-cell-contact claim. Three original negative operands remain preserved; per-cell native contacts await the coordinator accepted-code/custody work. Native diagnostic was not rerun by this worker.

finite_assessment.conclusion: The substantive original-source gap is now narrowed from generic metadata to actual historical digitization and named cleanup provenance. The inspected sources do not determine whether the three SSD inputs apply to individual Ango cells or justify clearing any hold. Source lineage alone is not researched-unresolved acceptance.
finite_assessment.remaining: Exact original map-sheet/registration and DRC-edge construction evidence is not identified; no immediately readable decisive DRC-specific construction instrument was found in the bounded exact-source searches. Native per-cell contact attribution remains a separate coordinator task.
finite_assessment.next_step: Use the exact source assessment with actual native operand contacts when available. Pursue further cartographic source work only if a specific relevant sheet/control record is identified; do not repeat generic searches or substitute modern geometry.
